user.title: Polish fuel prices GOV.PL
user.description: Add the integration that downloads maximum retail fuel prices published by the Polish Ministry of Energy on gov.pl. Data is checked automatically every 30 minutes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This integration can only be configured once.

init.title: Fuel price notifications
init.description: Configure daily notifications. Select phones registered by the Home Assistant Companion app. You can edit the list later.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Master switch for all notifications from this integration.
data_description.notification_time: Time used by delivery modes with scheduled sending.
data_description.notification_mode: By default the integration sends at the selected time. If tomorrow's prices are not available yet, it waits and sends immediately after publication is detected.
data_description.notification_services: Select one or more phones. Each phone is configured separately in the next step.

device.title: Phone {position}/{count}: {device}
device.description: Home Assistant target: `{target}`. You can set a custom name, disable the phone without removing it from the list, and send a test while saving.

data_description.device_name: Enter a custom name or keep the default name.
data_description.device_enabled: When disabled, the phone stays on the list but is skipped for daily notifications.
data_description.test_notification: When selected, the integration sends a test only to this phone using `ttl: 0` and `priority: high`.

error.test_notification_failed: The test notification could not be sent. Check that the selected phone has an active notify.mobile_app service.

options.on_publication: Immediately after new prices are published
options.scheduled_then_publication: At the configured time, or immediately after publication if prices are not available yet (default)
